name: com.ironmind.editor-presence
description: Streams the current Unity Editor selection to a DevGame chat composer over the Editor Presence Protocol (EPP). Selection-only: everything else Unity needs (play/stop/pause, status, console, tests, screenshots) goes through Unity's own official com.unity.pipeline package, not this one. See docs/workbench/spec-editor-presence.md and unity/README.md in the DevGame repo. Editor-only; nothing in this package ships in a player build.
